messages:
natalie_csm: Quick heads-up — we have 25 gated seats for the Pilot cohort and a waitlist. Need to finalize the invite list by EOD Thu so infra can provision sandboxes. Can owners triage priority candidates and confirm outreach owners?

omar_se: I can help export the request data after my meeting at 3pm. What are we using as priority buckets — renewal risk, ARR, or 'active dev env'?

jess_product: Prioritize teams with an active dev env + >100k tokens/month trial traffic. Also bump accounts with compliance needs for Private to the top so legal review happens early.

paul_csm: I'll assemble a CSV. Which columns should I include? name, email, account_id, SM-owner, risk-tier, current-usage, compliance-required?

natalie_csm: Yes — plus add 'opt_in_reasons' and 'preferred_contact_time'. Sample row:
```
account_id,email,name,sm_owner,risk_tier,current_usage,compliance,opt_in_reasons,contact_window
AC-324,alice@finco.com,Alice Chen,Sandra,high,120k,no,early adopter,AM
```

maria_eng: We can provision dedicated sandboxes but need the list by 5pm Thu to enqueue infra jobs for overnight setup.

sre-bot: Automated note: infra queue ETA ~14h once final list is received and validated.

omar_se: Sent initial export to @natalie_csm and @paul_csm (gsuite link). Included last 30-day usage and feature flags.

jess_product: Drafting a short feedback flow: 3 in-product prompts + one 30-min interview per account. Will add the prompts to the doc by EOD.

paul_csm: Outreach template coming — will personalize by 'opt_in_reasons' and include one ask: "What are your top 2 goals for Pilot?" Pinging legal on consent language for telemetry.

legal_bot: Reminder: signed DPA required for any account flagged "compliance=yes" prior to provisioning. Please route to Legal ops.

natalie_csm: Timeline: final CSV by Thu 17:00, infra-ready list by Thu 17:30, invites Fri morning. Owners: please confirm you can deliver by EOD today. :thumbsup:

jess_product: Confirmed.

omar_se: Confirmed — I'll follow up if anything is missing in the export.

paul_csm: On it, will share CSV in the thread when done.

maria_eng: Noted — prep automation for sandbox names so we can match accounts to infra jobs.
